$comment: Rule catalog — verification and code quality. Standards 9, 38.

rules.title: Work is verified before it is called complete
rules.description: Tests, builds, migrations, or validation tools are run after implementation rather than success being declared from code inspection.
rules.rationale: Implemented and verified are different states, and only one of them is COMPLETE.
rules.remediation: Add a test surface or verification command, and run it before marking work complete.
rules.$assuranceNote: The evaluator observes whether a test surface exists. It does not observe whether it was run, nor whether it covers the work.

rules.title: No placeholder implementations or knowingly broken tests
rules.description: Stubs returning constants, unimplemented paths, skipped tests, and disabled checks are either finished or removed.
rules.rationale: A placeholder is false green at the structural level: a check that the thing exists passes, and it does not work.
rules.remediation: Finish it, remove it, or record it as DEFERRED in the plan with a reason.
rules.$assuranceNote: Detection is marker-based and heuristic. Findings are INFERRED and advisory.

rules.title: Unreachable or superseded code is removed
rules.description: Code no longer reachable from any entry point is deleted rather than left in place.
rules.rationale: Dead code is read as live by anyone maintaining the system, including agents.
rules.remediation: Confirm reachability, then delete. Do not comment it out.
rules.$assuranceNote: Reachability is not computed. Findings are naming-convention guesses, INFERRED and never a failure.
